George MacDonald, The Princess and Curdie.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/george-macdonald/the-princess-and-curdie

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- George MacDonald, the author, died 1905 (Wikidata Q368519, P570 = 1905-09-18).

First publication of the text used: 1883, United Kingdom (SE colophon: 'The Princess and Curdie was published in 1883 by George MacDonald.'; Wikipedia infobox for The Princess and Curdie: publication place United Kingdom, publication date 1883, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Princess_and_Curdie).

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1883, before 1931;
  a published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after
  publication, so this work entered it in 1978.
- Country of origin (United Kingdom): copyright there lasts for life plus 70 years
  after the death of the last surviving person named above. The last to die
  did so in 1905, so the work entered the public domain there on
  1 January 1976.

They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
